# Vishnu Roshan

> Senior Software Engineer with eight years building full-stack web and mobile products across healthcare, e-commerce, logistics, and HR technology. Recent work spans retrieval and LLM systems in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Python.

## About

- Based in Chennai, India.
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python.
- Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, PWAs, accessibility, web performance.
- Backend and data: Node.js, Express, REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, pgvector, Celery, RabbitMQ.
- Cloud and delivery: AWS, Cloudflare, Docker, Jenkins.
- Testing: Jest, Vitest, Playwright.
- AI: LiteLLM, vector search, hybrid search.

## Experience

- **Sedin Technologies, Railsfactory Division** (Oct 2020 to present). Software Engineer, then Senior Software Engineer from Jan 2023. Delivered 10 to 12 client projects across healthcare, e-commerce, publishing, warehouse management, HR technology, and retail analytics. Migrated vector storage from ChromaDB to pgvector and implemented hybrid search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
- **Teknuance Info Solutions** (Jul 2019 to Jun 2020). Software Engineer. REST APIs in Node.js over PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Owned Olimium, a real-time chat application on WebSockets.
- **Bionworks Technologies, now part of IQVIA** (May 2018 to Jun 2019). Full Stack Developer. Built Healthcommand, a secure family health record application. Contributed core modules to Healthplug MD, a mobile-first EMR, and Healthplug PX, its patient engagement app.
- **Aosta Software Solutions** (Dec 2017 to May 2018). Software Engineer Intern.

## Playground

- [Zero Hero](https://zerohero.vishnuroshan.in/): a numbers puzzle game built with React, TypeScript, and Vite for the GMTK Game Jam 2026.
- [Lovedoku](https://lovedoku.vercel.app/): an ad-free Sudoku app with a custom puzzle-generation algorithm.
- [Steam Lib](https://steamlib.vercel.app/): browse and manage Steam game libraries, built with Next.js on the Steam and IGDB APIs.
- [tui-tac-toe](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tuitactoe): a terminal Tic Tac Toe game built with Ink. Run it with `npx tuitactoe`.
